text.tspan: Review draft 03 | One-sheet overview | Gold supply lines = electricity | Optional storage routes shown below
Effluent after heat recovery -> product cooling
Each train: compressor + feed exchanger + trim heater + reactor.
* V-301 conceptual: separation duties and water / oxygen
handling are not separately modelled. V-302 conditional:
built only when CH4 product storage is the storage method.
OPTIONAL LONG-TERM STORAGE | Battery OR H2 OR paired H2 + CO2 OR the CH4 product buffer V-302 above. Header references connect to the main process above.

H2 feeds the reactor first; the fuel cell covers remaining power demand. Paired storage uses both gas tanks. EB-01 boxes are the same electrical bus. CH4 product storage instead buffers the product in V-302 and builds none of these.
Blue = material | Gold = electricity, including electric heating / hold duty | Olive = solids | Crossings without dots are not connections.
Reactor symbols are schematic; only the Sabatier trains are parallel in this model. Stream values are placeholders. Review draft, ARPH 2026.
